connectors.name: Acunetix
connectors.author: oasm
connectors.description: Connects to an Acunetix instance, runs a scan against a target, and streams the discovered vulnerabilities back to the Worker.

target.description: Target URL or hostname to scan.
target.title: Scan target

apiKey.description: Acunetix API key sent in the X-Auth header.
apiKey.title: API key

criticality.description: Target business criticality: 30 Critical, 20 High, 10 Normal, 0 Low.
criticality.title: Target criticality

disableTlsChecks.description: Skip TLS certificate verification (required for the self-signed certificate Acunetix ships by default).
disableTlsChecks.title: Disable TLS checks

maxScanTime.description: Maximum scan duration in minutes; 0 uses the Acunetix default.
maxScanTime.title: Max scan time (minutes)

profileId.description: Scan type (profile) UUID. Defaults to Full Scan.
profileId.title: Scanning profile ID

targetDescription.description: Description stored on the Acunetix target created for this scan. Defaults to oasm-scan.
targetDescription.title: Target description

url.description: Base URL of the Acunetix instance (https://host:3443 for on-premises, https://app.invicti.com for Acunetix Online). /api/v1 is appended when absent.
url.title: Acunetix URL

connectors.name: Gau - GetAllUrls
connectors.author: oasm
connectors.shortDescription: Historical URL discovery via public archives
connectors.description: Discovers historical/archived URLs for a domain using Gau (GetAllUrls) across Wayback Machine, Common Crawl, AlienVault OTX and urlscan.io.

target.description: Domain (or URL) to discover historical URLs for. Scheme/path stripped to the host.
target.title: Target domain

providers.description: Archive providers to query. Default: all four.
providers.title: Providers

threads.description: Number of worker threads per provider (gau --threads).
threads.title: Threads

connectors.name: Katana - Web Crawler
connectors.author: oasm
connectors.description: Crawls a target website with Katana (ProjectDiscovery) up to a configurable depth and streams every discovered HTTP/HTTPS URL as a finding for URL discovery.

target.description: Domain (or URL) to crawl. Scheme/path stripped to the host.
target.title: Target domain

crawlDuration.description: Wall-clock budget for the crawl; 0 = unbounded (katana -ct). The adapter always enforces a 10 minute hard timeout.
crawlDuration.title: Crawl duration (seconds)

crawlScope.description: In-scope URL regex to follow (katana -cs). Default scope stays the registered domain (rdn).
crawlScope.title: Crawl scope regex

extensionFilter.description: Drop URLs with these extensions (katana -ef), e.g. png, css.
extensionFilter.title: Filter extensions

extensionMatch.description: Only emit URLs with these extensions (katana -em), e.g. php, html.
extensionMatch.title: Match extensions

filterSimilar.description: Collapse near-duplicate URLs (katana -fsu). Dramatically reduces volume on some sites.
filterSimilar.title: Filter similar URLs

filterSimilarThreshold.description: Similarity threshold percentage for -fsu (katana -fst). Only applied when filterSimilar is on.
filterSimilarThreshold.title: Similar-URL threshold

headers.description: Header lines in "Name: Value" form, sent on every request (katana -H). Values containing commas are quoted automatically.
headers.title: Headers

jsCrawl.description: Extract endpoints from JavaScript files (katana -jc). No browser required.
jsCrawl.title: Parse JavaScript

maxDomainPages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl per domain, 0 = unlimited (katana -mdp). Note: caps pages, not discovered URLs.
maxDomainPages.title: Max domain pages

maxUrls.description: Hard cap on emitted findings. When reached, the crawl is stopped and partial results are kept.
maxUrls.title: Max URLs (adapter cap)

parallelism.description: Number of concurrent inputs to process (katana -p).
parallelism.title: Parallelism

proxy.description: Proxy URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080 or socks5://127.0.0.1:9050 (katana -proxy).
proxy.title: Proxy

connectors.name: Nessus
connectors.author: oasm
connectors.description: Connects to a Tenable Nessus instance, creates and runs a scan against a target, and streams the discovered vulnerabilities back to the Worker as JSONL findings.

target.description: Target URL or hostname to scan.
target.title: Scan target

accessKey.description: Nessus API access key, paired with secretKey.
accessKey.title: API access key

folderId.description: ID of the Nessus folder that will contain the scan.
folderId.title: Folder ID

policyId.description: ID of an existing Nessus scan policy.
policyId.title: Policy ID

secretKey.description: Nessus API secret key, paired with accessKey.
secretKey.title: API secret key

templateUuid.description: UUID of the Nessus scan template to use.
templateUuid.title: Scan template UUID

url.description: Base URL of the Nessus instance.
url.title: Nessus URL

connectors.name: Nikto - Web Server Scanner
connectors.author: oasm
connectors.shortDescription: Signature-based web server and CGI scanner
connectors.description: Scans a web server for 7,000+ known issues: dangerous files and CGIs, outdated server software, missing security headers, and version-specific flaws. Each finding is classified from Nikto's own test database and correlated with CVE references.

target.description: Target URL or hostname. A bare host is prefixed with https://; an explicit port is preserved (example.com:8443).
target.title: Scan target

evasion.description: LibWhisker IDS evasion technique numbers (nikto -evasion), e.g. "1234".
evasion.title: IDS evasion

followRedirects.description: Follow 3xx redirects to their new location (nikto -followredirects).
followRedirects.title: Follow redirects

headers.description: Additional headers sent with every request (nikto -Add-header), one "Name: Value" per entry.
headers.title: Extra headers

maxTime.description: Optional self-imposed budget for the whole scan (nikto -maxtime), e.g. 1h, 30m, 600s. Leave empty to let the scan run to completion with no time limit.
maxTime.title: Max time per host

no404.description: Disable Nikto trying to guess a bespoke 404 page (nikto -no404).
no404.title: Skip 404 guessing

noCookies.description: Do not send cookies received from the server in later requests (nikto -nocookies).
noCookies.title: Ignore cookies

noLookup.description: Skip DNS lookups of the target host (nikto -nolookup).
noLookup.title: Skip DNS lookup

password.description: Password paired with the username for HTTP Basic authentication.
password.title: HTTP auth password

pause.description: Seconds to wait between tests, to reduce load on the target (nikto -Pause).
pause.title: Pause between tests (seconds)

plugins.description: Plugin list to run (nikto -Plugins), e.g. "tests(report:500)" or "@@NONE;tests".
plugins.title: Plugins

ports.description: Ports to scan (nikto -port), e.g. "80,443" or a range "8000-8100". Cannot be combined with a full URL target.
ports.title: Ports

proxy.description: Proxy URL for requests (nikto -useproxy), e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080.
proxy.title: Proxy

root.description: Prepend this path to every request (nikto -root), e.g. /app for a site mounted under a subdirectory.
root.title: Root path

ssl.description: Force SSL mode on the target port (nikto -ssl).
ssl.title: Force SSL

tuning.description: Test selection codes (nikto -Tuning) controlling which checks run, e.g. "123b" or "x" to exclude. Empty runs the tuned default set.
tuning.title: Tuning

userAgent.description: Force a specific User-Agent string (nikto -useragent). By default Nikto sends a static Chrome UA.
userAgent.title: User agent

vhost.description: Host header to use in requests (nikto -vhost).
vhost.title: Virtual host

connectors.name: Nmap - Port Scanner
connectors.author: oasm
connectors.description: Scans a single host with Nmap (Nmap Security Scanner) and streams every open port as a finding for port scanning: one finding per protocol/port with its Nmap service name, product and version. Unprivileged TCP connect scan; requires no raw sockets.

target.description: Host to scan: a hostname, an IPv4 literal, or a bracketed IPv6 literal. Scheme and path are stripped; CIDR ranges, lists and wildcards are rejected.
target.title: Target host

hostTimeout.description: Give up on the host after this long (nmap --host-timeout) and report what was found. Raise it for slow or heavily filtered targets; 0 = no per-host limit. The adapter always enforces a 20 minute hard timeout for the whole run.
hostTimeout.title: Per-host timeout (seconds)

noPing.description: Treat the host as up and skip the ping check (nmap -Pn). Keep enabled for firewalled or NAT-ed hosts; disable only when you want a ping failure to end the scan early.
noPing.title: Skip host discovery

ports.description: Port specification handed to nmap -p, e.g. "22,80,443" or "1-1024". Digits, commas and hyphens only. When empty, nmap scans its default top-1000 TCP ports (or topPorts below).
ports.title: Ports

retries.description: Maximum probe retransmissions per port (nmap --max-retries). Lower is faster on filtered hosts; raise it for lossy links.
retries.title: Max retries

topPorts.description: Scan the N most common ports (nmap --top-ports). Ignored when ports is set. 1000 = nmap's own default port list.
topPorts.title: Top ports

connectors.name: Nuclei
connectors.author: oasm
connectors.description: Runs ProjectDiscovery Nuclei template-based scans against a target URL to detect known vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and exposed secrets.

target.description: Target URL or hostname to scan.
target.title: Scan target

excludeTags.description: Skip templates that match these tags.
excludeTags.title: Excluded tags

followRedirects.description: Follow HTTP redirects during the scan.
followRedirects.title: Follow redirects

severity.description: Only report findings at the selected severity levels.
severity.title: Severity levels

tags.description: Only run templates matching these tags.
tags.title: Template tags

templateIds.description: Only run these specific template IDs.
templateIds.title: Template IDs

connectors.name: OWASP ZAP - Web Application Scanner
connectors.author: oasm
connectors.shortDescription: OWASP ZAP dynamic web application scanner
connectors.description: Runs OWASP ZAP (Zed Attack Proxy) against a target web application using the Automation Framework, then streams the discovered alerts back to the Worker as normalized findings.

target.description: Target URL to scan. A bare host is prefixed with https://.
target.title: Scan target

delayInMs.description: Delay between active scan requests, to reduce load on the target.
delayInMs.title: Request delay (ms)

enableAjaxSpider.description: Also run the AJAX spider (requires a browser in the image; slower).
enableAjaxSpider.title: AJAX spider

maxScanDurationInMins.description: Maximum time the active scanner may run. Only used when scanMode is full.
maxScanDurationInMins.title: Active scan duration (minutes)

maxSpiderDepth.description: Maximum link depth the spider follows.
maxSpiderDepth.title: Spider depth

maxSpiderDuration.description: Wall-clock budget for the spider and passive scan wait.
maxSpiderDuration.title: Spider duration (minutes)

policy.description: Active scan policy name. Only used when scanMode is full.
policy.title: Scan policy

scanMode.description: baseline runs the spider and passive scanner only (safe). full additionally runs the active scanner, which actively attacks the target — use only with permission.
scanMode.title: Scan mode

threadPerHost.description: Maximum active scan threads per host.
threadPerHost.title: Threads per host

connectors.name: RustScan - Port Scanner
connectors.author: oasm
connectors.description: Scans a single host with RustScan in greppable mode and streams every open port as a finding for port scanning: one finding per protocol/port. Async TCP connect scan; needs no raw sockets, no privileges and no nmap, so findings carry no service or version — run the Nmap connector alongside it for service detection.

target.description: Host to scan: a hostname, an IPv4 literal, or a bracketed IPv6 literal. Scheme and path are stripped; CIDR ranges, lists and wildcards are rejected.
target.title: Target host

batchSize.description: Concurrent sockets per batch (rustscan -b). 0 = rustscan default (4500). Lower it on lossy links or when the target complains; raise it only up to the worker container file limit.
batchSize.title: Batch size

ports.description: Comma-separated ports handed to rustscan -p, e.g. "22,80,443". Numbers only — a range belongs in "range" (rustscan -p rejects "1-1024"). Takes precedence over range.
ports.title: Ports

range.description: Inclusive start-end range handed to rustscan -r, e.g. "1-1024". Ignored when ports is set. When neither ports nor range is set, rustscan scans its own default: the full 1-65535 range.
range.title: Port range

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait before a port counts as closed (rustscan -t). 0 = rustscan default (1500). Raise it for high-latency or heavily filtered targets.
timeoutMs.title: Port timeout (milliseconds)

tries.description: Probe attempts before a port counts as closed (rustscan --tries). 0 = rustscan default (1).
tries.title: Tries per port

udp.description: Scan UDP ports instead of TCP (rustscan --udp). Findings are then reported with the udp protocol prefix, e.g. "udp/53".
udp.title: UDP scan

connectors.name: WPScan - WordPress Security Scanner
connectors.author: oasm
connectors.description: Scans WordPress sites using WPScan to enumerate vulnerable plugins and themes, detect known CVEs, misconfigurations, and weak credentials.

target.description: Target URL or hostname to scan.
target.title: Scan target

apiToken.description: API token from wpscan.com used to display vulnerability data. If omitted, the WPSCAN_API_TOKEN environment variable is used.
apiToken.title: WPScan API token

cookieString.description: Cookie string to send with requests, e.g. "cookie1=value1; cookie2=value2".
cookieString.title: Cookie string

detectionMode.description: Global detection mode used by all detections.
detectionMode.title: Detection mode

enumerate.description: Enumeration codes: vp/ap/p plugins, vt/at/t themes, tt timthumbs, cb config backups, dbe db exports, u users, m media.
enumerate.title: Enumeration

excludeContentBased.description: Exclude responses matching this regexp/string during enumeration.
excludeContentBased.title: Exclude content based

force.description: Do not check whether the target is running WordPress or returns 403.
force.title: Force scan

headers.description: Additional headers added to requests, separated by "; ".
headers.title: Extra headers

httpAuth.description: HTTP Basic authentication credentials in login:password form.
httpAuth.title: HTTP basic auth

ignoreMainRedirect.description: Ignore the main redirect (if any) and scan the target URL.
ignoreMainRedirect.title: Ignore main redirect

maxThreads.description: Maximum number of threads to use.
maxThreads.title: Max threads

pluginsDetection.description: Detection mode used to enumerate plugins.
pluginsDetection.title: Plugins detection

pluginsVersionDetection.description: Detection mode used to check plugins versions.
pluginsVersionDetection.title: Plugins version detection

randomUserAgent.description: Use a random User-Agent for each scan.
randomUserAgent.title: Random user agent

server.description: Force the supplied server module instead of auto-detecting.
server.title: Web server

stealthy.description: Alias for --random-user-agent plus passive detection modes.
stealthy.title: Stealthy

themesDetection.description: Detection mode used to enumerate themes.
themesDetection.title: Themes detection

themesVersionDetection.description: Detection mode used to check themes versions.
themesVersionDetection.title: Themes version detection

throttle.description: Milliseconds to wait before each request. When set, max threads is forced to 1.
throttle.title: Throttle

update.description: Force (true) or skip (false) the WPScan database update before scanning. Omit to use the WPScan default.
update.title: Update database

vhost.description: Host header to use in requests.
vhost.title: Virtual host
